registration.deadline: 5K price increases to $25 after February 12, 2027 at 11:59 PM CST; race-day 5K pricing is listed for March 13, 2027.

runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before March 13 at Hoover's Veterans Park.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for start time, pricing, scholarship mission, packet pickup, activities, and awards.

items.label: Start window
items.detail: RunSignup lists the 2027 in-person 5K start at 9:00 AM CST and end at noon.

items.label: Cause

items.label: Family Fun Day
items.value: Popcorn, cotton candy, DJ, face painting
items.detail: The official race description invites participants to enjoy free popcorn, cotton candy, other treats, a DJ, face painting, and more.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.detail: The race description lists packet pickup in the lobby of the Judy M. Merritt Health Science building on Thursday from 1:00-4:00 PM and Friday from 9:00 AM-4:00 PM, plus race-day pickup from 7:30-8:30 AM at the Veterans Park Pavilion.

items.label: Awards
items.detail: Jefferson State's official race details page lists medals for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place top male and female overall, plus top male and female runners in age categories from 12 & under through 60+.

story.title: A community 5K honoring Dr. Judy M. Merritt and supporting student scholarships.
paragraphs: Jefferson State describes the annual Judy M. Merritt Memorial 5K as a race held in honor of former president Dr. Judy M. Merritt, who served as president for 35 years and was the first female president of an Alabama college.
The 2027 RunSignup page keeps the race centered on the student-scholarship mission: run, walk, or sleep in to support Jefferson State students in need.
For families, the event pairs a 9:00 AM 5K at Hoover's Veterans Park with Family Fun Day activities including free popcorn, cotton candy, a DJ, face painting, and more.
